caption:
"Paid 100 for coffee, 150 for a taxi, 350 for sunblock." That was three expenses, logged in one breath.

Here's the part that made me actually keep using it. That sentence never left my phone. Tanda turns your voice into text on the device, sorts it into a budget, and the audio stays local. No bank login. No upload. No form asking me to pick a category at 11pm.

Every other app died on me by day five because typing each coffee felt like a second job. This one I just talk to. Five seconds, phone back in my pocket, and by the end of the week there's a real zero-based budget sitting on top of it instead of a pile of receipts.

Won't claim it reads your mind. It won't touch your bank. It just listens when you say what you spent, and keeps that between you and your phone.

Save this if you've quit a budget app before.

script: Every budget app I downloaded died by day five. Typing in every coffee felt like homework. So I tried just saying it. Paid a hundred for coffee, one fifty for a taxi, three fifty for sunblock. Three expenses, one breath, done. And here's what kept me. That voice never leaves my phone. No bank login. No upload. It just turns what I said into a real budget. Say what you spent. Your voice stays on your phone.
